facts.statement: A validation run returned exit code 1 with `IndentationError: unexpected indent` in `portfolio_optimizer.py`.
The agent read the offending lines and edited the indentation.
The next run returned exit code 0 and generated 242 navigation and weight records, but two reported metrics were infinite.
The agent made additional edits to benchmark-return and excess-return calculations after observing the infinite metrics.
A final command returned exit code 0, ran the program, passed Python compilation, checked 242 result rows, ten weights per row, and finite numeric metrics.

The final validation directly checked the listed structural and finiteness assertions; the frozen evidence does not contain a post-repair check for every other strategy requirement outside those listed assertions.

claim_set.statement: An explicit code-execution failure occurred during validation.
The agent diagnosed and edited the code after the failure.
A later validation command completed successfully and passed the listed assertions.
The final validation scope was limited to the checks explicitly listed in the command.

missing_facts: A post-repair validation event explicitly rechecking every requested strategy requirement beyond the listed structural, compilation, and finiteness checks.
